numberOfRegistries.description:
Number the {@link Sensor}s, {@link ExpectedSensor}s, and {@link ReliabilityAssetEvent}s created
for the test data. The minimum value is 12.

assetEventsCheck.description: If is set to COMPLETE create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} with {@link ReliabilityAssetEvent}s.

doSensorsExistForMlModeling.description:
If is set to COMPLETE create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} with IS related by a {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}.
If is set to WARNING_NO_SENSORS_RELATION create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} without IS related by a {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}.
If is set to WARNING_SENSORS_NOT_INSTRUMENTED create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} with a not IS related by a {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}.

loadCriticalSensors.description:
If set to true, creates 2 Critical Sensors in addition to the {@link #numberOfRegistries} sensors being created.

A Sensor is deemed to be critical, if it has abnormal values (like 0,1000) for a certain period of time.
The Critical sensors created currently have abnormal values for 2 month period.
For example, if `numberOfRegistries` is 6 and `loadCriticalSensors` is set to true, total 8 Sensors will be created, of which 2 are critical.

makeCriticalSensorFlatLine.description:
If set to `true`, one of the critical sensors created will have flatlining data for an entire year.
This option is not respected if {@link #loadCriticalSensors} is set to `false`.

sensorTimeSeriesExist.description: If set to COMPLETE create {@link Sensor}s with a {@link PointPhysicalMeasurementSeries} for the {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

sensorsNormalizationCheck.description: If set to COMPLETE create normalized {@link Sensor}s for the {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

assetClassField.description: If set to COMPLETE create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} with an {@link AssetClass}.

expectedSensorSensorCheck.description: If set to COMPLETE create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} with {@link ExpectedSensor}s related with {@link Sensor}s.

sensorExpectedSensorCheck.description: If set to COMPLETE create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} with {@link Sensor}s related with {@link ExpectedSensor}s.

expectedSensorFeatureCheck.description: If set to COMPLETE create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} with {@link ExpectedSensor}s with {@link Feature}.

sensorFeatureCheck.description: If set to COMPLETE create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} with {@link Sensor}s with {@link Feature}.

failureModeLibraryCheck.description: If set to COMPLETE create a {@link ReliabilityAsset} without {@link FailureModeLibrary}.

assetName.description: The optional name of the {@link ReliabilityAsset} to be created.

unit.description:
The optional units of the {@link PointMeasurement}s created on the {@link Sensor}s for the asset.
By default, 'rpm' is used.

title: Type as an input argument for {@link ReliabilityDataValidationTestDataOptions} to create basic test data for Reliability Data Validation.
name: ReliabilityDataValidationTestDataOptions
